title: Double Dutch
tagline: Hop between two ropes, in time, with tricks.
description: A rhythm game about double dutch, the street game of jumping between two ropes turned in opposite directions. Tap to hop as each rope reaches the pavement, swipe to add a tuck, spin, kick or touch down, and keep the streak through eight blocks from the stoop to the final round. Watch and Learn, Practice, a Rules page with large text, original sounds, works offline.
howToPlay: Pick a block. Two friends turn the ropes and you hop between them.
Tap anywhere as the rope reaches the pavement: the top of your hop on the beat.
When a call shows, swipe that way during the hop: up tuck, left spin, right kick, down touch down.
Pepper beats pass the ropes twice in one beat: keep hopping light and quick.
Three tangles and the round ends: try the block again.
Watch and Learn shows the routine, then jumps it for you.
On a keyboard: Space hops, arrow keys hop with a trick, P pauses.
